data.exact_reserve_text:
Favourable movements of $27.6m (2022: $34.4m favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
Technical provision balances relating to the 2020 and prior years of account were transferred through Reinsurance to Close (RITC) to Syndicate 2008 on 1 January 2023.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close transfer to Syndicate 2008
prior_year_events.impact_description: Technical provision balances relating to the 2020 and prior years were transferred to Syndicate 2008, reducing the syndicate's gross claims outstanding by the gross RITC amount.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were USD 786.531m. Using the gross claims development table, prior-year re-estimation for underwriting years older than 2022 (principally 2021) produced an adverse (strengthening) movement of approximately USD 22.1m (2.8% of opening gross reserves). The year was also affected by a Reinsurance-to-Close transfer on 1 January 2023 which moved gross technical provisions relating to 2020 and prior off the balance sheet (gross RITC c. USD 284.3m). The report separately discloses net favourable movements of USD 27.6m in the past year's provision (net of reinsurance).
raw_causal_phrases: a decrease in large catastrophe losses compared to the previous year, leading to improved gross loss ratios, and positive adjustments to prior year claims across most lines of business.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (Statement of financial position: liabilities). Prior-year development gross figure was calculated from the gross claims development ('Pure underwriting estimate - gross') table (page 68) by excluding the two most recent years (2023, 2022) and comparing the previous diagonal for 2021 - this yields +22.1m (adverse). The report also discloses a net favourable movement of $27.6m (net of reinsurance) - net and gross differ materially. A large RITC transfer (gross $284.285m) affecting 2020 & prior materially changes balances and can distort year-on-year movements. Line-of-business breakdowns of prior-year movement are only presented net of reinsurance in the claims note; gross LOB movements were not available, so LOB movements shown are net amounts from the claims note (confidence high for those net figures, but they are NOT gross).
